x: Birchfield had a good four running for them and although Vic Blowfield gave us the lead on the first leg, which Ted Stimpson maintained on the second stage, Bill Lucas had to give way to Reeves of Birchfield and Bobby Reid went off with a good lead from George Lucas for the last lap.
A Club mile handicap saw Boreham, Dooley and Reeves take the awards in that order. A team walk of two miles gave Belgrave a win over the Met.
First Class Standard (15.35):- T.Davies, R,Linstead, K.Millar, R.Black, E.Gebbett, A.Bruce, J.Masters, C.Shippam, Reeves, Robinson. Second Class Standard (16.00):- F.Wright, R.Berkshire, E.Short.
